name: CreateAttestationV1
note: attestor_pub stored from params; `attestor_secret: zero // Not stored`

name: RevokeAttestationV1
state_checks: attestation exists; params.attestor_pub == stored attestor_pub; state Active
note: no circuit; the compared field is a *public* key anyone can copy onto the wire

name: CreateClaimV1
state_checks: attestation Active & unexpired; predicate matches or Custom; claim_id unique; rate limit: 1 block per (attestation, claimant_pub)

name: VerifyClaimV1
state_checks: claim Pending; attestation Active; claim.attestation_id == params; evidence_commitment == params; verified := revealed_result != 0
note: comments say the circuit constrains revealed_result; VerifyClaimV2 constrains only the tx pair

name: ConsumeClaimV1
public_inputs: claim_id claimant_pub.x claimant_pub.y nullifier tx_binding tx_nonce
state_checks: claim Verified; claim.claimant_pub == params.claimant_pub; nullifier unspent
note: consumer_pub = ec_mul_base(consumer_secret, NULLIFIER_K); nullifier = H(1, claim_id, consumer_secret)

name: DelegateAttestationV1
note: publishes H(4, delegatee_pub) -- the *delegatee*, not the delegating attestor

name: VerifyChainV1
state_checks: each link exists and is Active
